title: EJP-45: Enforce i18n coverage via ESLint rule and locale key parity test

steps.title: Audit hardcoded UI strings across all Vue components
steps.summary: Scan every Vue component and view, catalogue each user-facing hardcoded string, and propose a namespaced dot-notation key for each
steps.instructions:
Read every .vue file under apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/views/ and apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/components/ (excluding components/ui/ which is shadcn auto-generated). For each file collect every string literal visible in the template that a user would read — button labels, placeholder text, section headings, empty-state messages, error notices, dialog titles, tooltip text, aria-labels. Ignore: CSS class strings, route path strings, event names, icon identifiers, code-only values.

Propose a dot-notation key for each string scoped to its feature area, e.g.:
- nav.sessions, nav.monitor, nav.planner
- common.cancel, common.save, common.remove, common.add
- github.prs.title, github.settings.token
- jira.noIssues, jira.settings.baseUrl
- settings.apiKey, settings.model

Write results to a temporary file at apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/locales/_audit.md as a markdown table: File | Hardcoded string | Proposed i18n key.

Do not modify any source files. This audit drives steps 2 and 3.

steps.title: Install vue-i18n, scaffold locales/en.json, wire plugin into main.ts
steps.summary: Add vue-i18n v9 dependency, create en.json from audit output, register the i18n plugin in the Vue entry point
steps.instructions:
1. Install vue-i18n:
   pnpm --filter @agentkeeper/desktop add vue-i18n@^9

2. Read _audit.md from step 1. Create apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/locales/en.json from all keys in the audit using flat dot-notation. Example structure:
```json
{
  "nav.sessions": "Sessions",
  "nav.monitor": "Monitor",
  "nav.planner": "Planner",
  "common.cancel": "Cancel",
  "common.save": "Save",
  "github.prs.title": "Pull Requests"
}
```
Use flat keys (not nested objects) — this makes the parity test in step 5 simple.

3. Create apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/i18n/index.ts:
```ts
import { createI18n } from 'vue-i18n'
import en from '../locales/en.json'
export const i18n = createI18n({
  legacy: false,
  locale: 'en',
  fallbackLocale: 'en',
  messages: { en }
})
```

4. In apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/main.ts, add:
```ts
import { i18n } from './i18n/index'
app.use(i18n)
```
(before app.mount())

5. Delete _audit.md after en.json is created.

6. Run `pnpm typecheck` from apps/desktop/ — must pass with no errors.

steps.title: Migrate all Vue components to use $t() instead of hardcoded strings
steps.summary: Replace every hardcoded user-facing string in views and components with $t() calls using keys from en.json

steps.title: Configure ESLint with @intlify/eslint-plugin-vue-i18n
steps.summary: Install ESLint and the vue-i18n plugin, create eslint.config.ts, enable no-raw-text and no-missing-keys rules

steps.title: Write Vitest locale key parity test
steps.summary: Create a Vitest test that reads all locale JSON files and asserts every file has exactly the same set of keys as en.json

steps.title: Wire check:i18n aggregate script and verify full pipeline
steps.summary: Add a single pnpm script combining lint and i18n test, run the full pipeline, confirm zero errors
steps.instructions:
1. In apps/desktop/package.json add:
   "check:i18n": "pnpm lint && pnpm test:i18n"

2. From the repo root run:
   pnpm --filter @agentkeeper/desktop check:i18n
   Must exit 0.

3. Also run `pnpm typecheck` from the repo root to confirm no TypeScript regressions.

4. If any errors surface, fix them before marking this step done.

5. Report the final state:
   - Total key count in en.json
   - Number of Vue files migrated to $t()
   - Active ESLint rules and their severity
   - Parity test pass/fail status
